900.2.10(958).explanation: Exception R 958 sets site-specific rules for these lands: it brings in exception 900.2.10(5), caps townhouses at three dwelling units, allows certain multi-unit uses that existed on March 13, 1978, and allows conversion of a detached house to two or more secondary suites if it has at least 140 square metres of interior floor area. Former City of Toronto by-law sections and by-laws also prevail on parts of the lands.

900.2.10(957).explanation: Exception R 957 brings in exception 900.2.10(5) and requires additions above the first storey of a lawfully existing detached house to meet the minimum building setbacks. Former City of Toronto by-law sections and by-laws also prevail on parts of the lands.

900.2.10(881).explanation: Exception R 881 brings in exception 900.2.10(4). Former City of Toronto by-law section 12(1) 434 and by-laws for 54 Aberdeen Ave. and 253 Wellesley St. E. also prevail.

900.2.10(805).explanation: Exception R 805 brings in exception 900.2.10(7). Former City of Toronto by-law 95-0289 and by-law 726-02 also prevail at the named Davenport Rd. addresses.
